answer_1.quote: ...In this work, we propose a novel primal-dual approach for question generation...

answer_2.quote: ...We evaluate the performance of our model with three standard evaluation metrics: BLEU (BLEU-4), METEOR and ROUGE-L...

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct a human evaluation to measure the quality of questions generated by our approach. ... We randomly sample 100 (answer, passage, question) triples ... We then ask three professional English speakers to rate the pairs in terms of the above criterion on a 1 to 5 scale (5 for the best).
answer_4.guideline: Three professional English speakers rated each generated question-answer pair on a 1‑to‑5 scale for Naturalness and Answerability.
